title: Connectivity of the de Bruijn digraph
statement: Fix an integer $n \ge 2$, and let $D_n$ be the de Bruijn digraph whose vertices are the binary strings of length $n-1$ and whose arcs run from each string $p_1 p_2 \cdots p_{n-1}$ to every string of the form $p_2 p_3 \cdots p_{n-1} b$ with $b \in \{0,1\}$. Form the underlying undirected simple graph on the same vertex set, in which two distinct strings are adjacent precisely when an arc of $D_n$ joins one to the other in either direction. Then this graph is connected: its vertex set is nonempty and any two vertices are linked by a path.
hypotheses_covered: the underlying inclusive simple graph of the de Bruijn digraph D_n is connected (nonempty and all vertices mutually reachable)
